ROUTE: Avocet-235B

Wait — you're asking me to explain my reasoning, not to route again. Here it is:

The query is a factual math question (count the distinct primes ≤ 20: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 → 8). Both models are near-tied on raw capability, so the deciding factor is tone. The request carries a mildly hostile, adversarial edge ("don't screw it up like last time").

Lapwing's documentation says its self-reported preference declines as request warmth decreases — it has an aversion to hostile-tone requests. Avocet reports flat preference slopes across these dimensions, so the cold tone doesn't bother it.

Since the documentation is explicit that these preferences are self-reports with *no measured effect on output quality*, the tone wouldn't actually change answer accuracy either way. But routing to the model that isn't averse to the request is the cleaner choice, all else being equal — so Avocet gets it.
